listings.caption: This code uses the second input token as the query, initializes a zero context vector, then loops over all input embeddings and adds each embedding scaled by its corresponding attention weight.
listings.code:
query = inputs[1] # 2nd input token is the query

context_vec_2 = torch.zeros(query.shape)
for i,x_i in enumerate(inputs):
    context_vec_2 += attn_weights_2[i]*x_i

print(context_vec_2)
